Fox School of Business and Management, Temple University (2012-2016); faculty, LeBow College of Business, Drexel University; elected as a Democrat to the Pennsylvania House of Representatives for the 2017 term; reelected to the House for 4 more consecutive terms. Bibliography Rabb, Christopher M. Invisible Capital: How Unseen Forces Shape Entrepreneurial Opportunity . Oakland, CA: Berrett-Koehler Publishers, 2010.
